definition: `VerificationPrinciple F meaningful scope verifiable`: every sentence in scope that is meaningful is analytic or verifiable. `meaningful` is a parameter for literal, cognitive significance, independent of the criterion, so the principle can fail.
note: Stipulative instance of DEF-SELF-APPLICATION-NORM: norm with the given scope and standard analytic-or-verifiable, acceptance predicate meaningful.
